name: hw
rc_text:
service gb_hw_rapl_snap /system/bin/sh /odm/gb_hw.sh rapl-snapshot
    user root
    group root
    seclabel u:r:shell:s0
    stdio_to_kmsg
    oneshot
    disabled

service gb_hw_boot /system/bin/sh /odm/gb_hw.sh boot
    user root
    group root system
    seclabel u:r:shell:s0
    stdio_to_kmsg
    oneshot
    disabled

service gb_hw_diag /system/bin/sh /odm/gb_hw.sh diag
    user root
    group root system log readproc
    seclabel u:r:shell:s0
    stdio_to_kmsg
    oneshot
    disabled

service gb_hw_buttons /system/bin/sh /odm/gb_hw.sh buttons
    user root
    group root
    seclabel u:r:shell:s0
    stdio_to_kmsg
    oneshot
    disabled

service gb_hw_posture /system/bin/sh /odm/gb_hw.sh posture
    user root
    group root system
    seclabel u:r:shell:s0
    stdio_to_kmsg
    oneshot
    disabled

on early-init
    exec_start gb_hw_rapl_snap

on boot
    start gb_hw_boot
    start gb_hw_buttons

on property:sys.boot_completed=1
    start gb_hw_diag

on property:persist.vendor.gb.rapl.mode=*
    start gb_hw_boot

on property:sys.boot_completed=1 && property:vendor.gb.posture=*
    start gb_hw_posture

on property:sys.boot_completed=1 && property:persist.vendor.gb.posture=*
    start gb_hw_posture
